title: Public telephone station and SMT bus station, upper Main St
description: Looking south down Main Street on the east side shows the unidentified lady standing in front of what was the Anna Martin building and earlier the head office of Farmers Telephone Exchange, with Mrs. Charles E Allen as the head operator. Her husband had his barbershop under the telephone office at street level.
